name: PRUDENTIAL PLC

ads_ratio.source: Prudential plc Form 20-F cover / registered security title for the NYSE listing: American Depositary Shares, each representing two ordinary shares of 5 pence each (EDGAR security title 'PRUDENTIAL PLC ADS (REP 2 ORD SHARES)'); the same 1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares ratio is stated in the filer's Form S-8/F-6 registrations
ads_ratio.reason: 20-F filer: EDGAR per-share figures are per ordinary share while the Nasdaq/NYSE price ($23.81) is per ADS; per-share figures must be scaled x2 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price. This also halves the engine's naive market-cap estimate (ordinary shares x ADS price).

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

fragility_flags: DATA_GAP:sbc — sbc missing for fiscal year(s) 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 — no tier emitted
STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency GBP converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x2.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Prudential plc Form 20-F cover / registered security title for the NYSE listing: American Depositary Shares, each representing two ordinary shares of 5 pence each (EDGAR security title 'PRUDENTIAL PLC ADS (REP 2 ORD SHARES)'); the same 1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares ratio is stated in the filer's Form S-8/F-6 registrations) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
note: DATA_GAP: required filing data is missing (see data_gap / data_gap_uncovered). v5 never emits a tier on an uncovered data gap — a missing value is not a zero.
